journal.text: First session 2025-07-01, $50k cash. Market bottomed early April then strong rebound into June 30. Bought 10 leaders at/near ATH with rising volume: MSFT, NVDA, META, AVGO, NFLX, CRWD, KLAC, AXON, BKNG, DASH, $5k each for diversification across mega-tech, semis, cyber, and consumer. Reconsider if trend breaks below 50-day or sharp reversal on volume; will review monthly with new deposits.

Hold all 10 positions on 2025-07-02. July 1 was broad pullback (-1% to -6%) after strong run into June 30 ATHs, on elevated volume, but no position broke its uptrend structure except intraday reversal; KLAC even closed up. Single down day does not justify locking losses with zero cash. Reconsider if July 2-3 confirms breakdown (close below 20-day / high-volume follow-through, especially AXON, AVGO, NFLX) then trim weakest to raise cash for redeploy.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-03. July 2 stabilized: NVDA +2.6%, KLAC +2.5% to new high, AVGO +2%, CRWD +0.8%, DASH +0.3% bounced; MSFT -0.2%, AXON -0.1%, BKNG -0.5%, NFLX -0.7%, META -0.8% drifted on low volume, no follow-through breakdown. Broad uptrend from April-June intact. No cash to redeploy, no justification to lock losses. Reconsider if AXON breaks below 756 low or META/NFLX accelerate down on high volume.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-07 (through July 3 close). July 3 confirmed stabilization: MSFT, NVDA, CRWD, KLAC made new highs, AVGO near high, AXON +2.7% recovered off 756 low, NFLX +1% bounced, META/BKNG/DASH flat on low holiday volume. July 1 pullback looks like single-day shakeout, no trend break. No cash, no reason to realize losses. Reconsider if META breaks below 712 or NFLX below 1271 on high volume, or if broad market reverses.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-08 (through July 7 close). July 7 confirms uptrend intact: BKNG +1.7% to new closing high, DASH +3.4% to new high on high volume, AXON +0.8% continued recovery; MSFT, NVDA, AVGO, META, NFLX held flat (-0.1% to -0.7%) on low volume near highs, no breakdown. CRWD -1.7% and KLAC -1.3% pulled back on moderate volume but remain well above June breakout levels. No cash, no trend break justifies selling. Reconsider if META breaks below 712, NFLX below 1271, or CRWD/KLAC show high-volume follow-through down.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-09 (through July 8 close). July 8 was mild pullback, no breakdown: NVDA +1.1% to 160 new high, KLAC +0.7% to 919 near high, CRWD +0.4% stabilized, META +0.3% held; MSFT -0.2% flat, AVGO -0.9%, NFLX -1.1% to 1275, AXON -1.5% to 790, BKNG -1.8% to 5713, DASH -2.2% to 241 on lower volume. NFLX intraday 1260 briefly under 1271 trigger but closed above at 1275; META held above 712. No high-volume trend break. No cash to redeploy. Reconsider if NFLX closes below 1271, META below 712, or BKNG/DASH follow through down on rising volume.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-10 (through July 9 close). July 9 was broad rebound: AVGO +2.2% to 277.9 new closing high, NVDA +1.8% to 162.88 new high on rising volume, META +1.7% to 732.8, MSFT +1.4% to 503.5 new high, AXON +2% to 805.9 recovery, DASH +1.9% to 246, CRWD +1.1% to 513.5, NFLX +1% to 1288 bounce holding above 1271 trigger, KLAC +0.4% to 923 near high. Only BKNG -0.8% to 5668 second-day pullback on lower volume, no breakdown. No cash to deploy. Reconsider if NFLX closes below 1271, META below 712, or BKNG extends below ~5650 on rising volume.

July 10 breakdown: NFLX -2.9% to 1250.59 below 1271 trigger on 4.23M high volume, CRWD -5.2% to 487.11 on 4.18M volume breaking below July 1 low, AXON -9% to 732.99 on 1.23M volume breaking prior lows. All three violate hold rules. Sold all three. Rotated into strength: AAPL +0.6% to 212.41 near high, AMD +4.2% to 144.16 breakout on 61M volume, AMAT +1.4% to 198.03 new high; semis (KLAC/LRCX/AMAT) intact. Hold MSFT NVDA META AVGO KLAC BKNG DASH. Reconsider if new buys break July 10 lows or if META/DASH follow through down on volume.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-14 (through July 11 close). July 11 mixed but no breakdown: NVDA +0.5% to 164.92 new high (intra 167.89) on 193M volume, AMD +1.6% to 146.42 breakout continuation on 50M, MSFT +0.4% to 503.32 near high, DASH +0.9% to 240.44 bounce after July 10 drop, BKNG flat at 5717, KLAC -0.4% to 924.58 high hold on low volume, AVGO -0.4% to 274.38 consolidation, AMAT flat 197.93, AAPL -0.6% to 211.16 holding above July 10 low. META -1.4% to 717.51 second down day on 10.9M volume but closed above 712 trigger. No cash to deploy. Reconsider if META closes below 712, DASH below 237.7, or AAPL/AMAT break July 10 lows.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-15 (through July 14 close). July 14 quiet/holding: BKNG +0.9% to 5766, DASH +1% to 242.85 bounce, META +0.5% to 720.92 holding above 712, AVGO +0.4% to 275.6, MSFT flat 503 on low volume, NVDA -0.5% to 164.07 on lower volume, AMD flat 146.24 with intraday dip to 141.9 recovered, KLAC -0.3% to 921.84 with dip to 906 recovered, AMAT -0.4% to 197.1 closing above 197. Only AAPL -1.2% to 208.62 third down day closing below July 10 intraday low but holding above July 9 low 207.2 on no volume expansion - not enough for cut, give room. No cash to deploy. Reconsider if AAPL closes below ~207, AMD/AMAT close below July 10 lows, or META below 712.

Hold all 10 on 2025-07-16 (through July 15 close). July 15 strong semis offset soft META/DASH: NVDA +4% to 170.70 gap breakout on 230M volume, AMD +6.4% to 155.61 breakout on 93M volume, AVGO +1.9% to 280.94 new high, KLAC +1.6% to 936.53 new high, MSFT +0.6% to 505.82 high, AMAT +1.1% to 199.29, AAPL +0.2% to 209.11 stabilizing above 207-208. Watchlist: META -1.5% to 710.39 (open 723.9 high 724.4 low 709.82) closed marginally below 712 trigger on 11.5M volume but held at/above July 11 intraday low 709.7 with off-low close; DASH -2.5% to 236.77 (low 234.6) closed just below 237.7 trigger on 3.48M volume but recovered +0.9% off low; BKNG -1.6% to 5675.53 low 5640 recovered to hold above 5660s. No decisive high-volume breakdown like July 10 cuts, more marginal support tests with intraday recovery. Hold for confirmation. No cash to deploy. Reconsider if META/DASH close below July 15 lows (709.8/234.6) on volume, or BKNG breaks 5640, AAPL below 207.

July 16 confirms breakdown in META/DASH, rotate to semis strength. META -1.1% to 702.91 (low 699.27) closed below July 15 low 709.82 and July 11 low 709.7 on 13.07M expanding volume vs 11.5M; second close below 712 trigger. DASH -1% to 234.5 (low 233.92) closed below July 15 low 234.6; second close below 237.7 trigger. Both met July 16 reconsideration trigger to cut. Sold all META (6.78u) and DASH (20.19u). Rotate proceeds to leaders: NVDA +0.4% to 171.37 holding July 15 gap breakout on 158M, AMD +2.9% to 160.08 breakout continuation on 59M. Hold MSFT flat 505.62 high, AVGO flat 280.81 high, KLAC -0.3% to 933.49 recovered from 897.38 intraday dip to close near high, BKNG -0.3% to 5658 off 5625 low holding, AAPL +0.5% to 210.16 stabilizing above 207, AMAT -2.25% to 194.81 gap down on 9.4M high volume but hold one day for confirmation off 189.75 low. Reconsider if AMAT closes below 189.75 or BKNG closes below 5625, or KLAC closes below 897.

Hold all 8 on 2025-07-18 (through July 17 close). July 17 confirms semis leadership, no breakdowns: MSFT +1.2% to 511.70 new high on 17.5M expanding volume, NVDA +0.95% to 173.00 holding July 15 gap breakout on 160M, AVGO +2% to 286.45 breakout new high on 17.2M expanding volume, KLAC +0.4% to 937.08 new high holding above 910 low on lower volume, BKNG +0.45% to 5683.94 low 5646.40 held above 5625 trigger on lower 141k volume, AMD +0.2% to 160.41 breakout consolidation on declining 50M volume, AAPL flat 210.02 stabilizing above 207, AMAT -1.2% to 192.52 low 191.95 held above 189.75 trigger on lower 5.7M vs 9.4M volume - selling eased. All July 17 reconsideration triggers avoided (AMAT>189.75, BKNG>5625, KLAC>897). Only $513 cash, no funds to rotate. Reconsider if AMAT closes below 189.75, BKNG below 5625, KLAC below 897, or NVDA/AMD close below July 16 lows (168.9/152.85).

Hold all 8 on 2025-07-21 (through July 18 close). July 18 mixed consolidation, no breakdowns: MSFT -0.3% to 510.05 faded from 514.64 high on 21.2M volume, holds near high; NVDA -0.3% to 172.41 holding July 15 gap breakout on lower 146M vs 160M; AVGO -1.1% to 283.34 normal pullback after 286.45 breakout on lower 15M; KLAC -0.6% to 931.12 faded from 945.87 open on low 682k; BKNG +0.3% to 5702.90 up on 147k, recovery continues; AAPL +0.55% to 211.18 stabilizing higher on 48.9M; AMD -2.1% to 156.99 weakest (low 155.81) but held above July 15 breakout 155.61 and July 16 low 152.85 on declining 48.8M volume; AMAT -1.1% to 190.44 low 190.14 held above 189.75 trigger on easing 4.75M vs 5.7M volume. All July 18 triggers avoided (AMAT>189.75, BKNG>5625, KLAC>897, NVDA>168.9, AMD>152.85). Only $513 cash. Reconsider if AMAT closes below 189.75, AMD below 155.6/152.85, or any semi closes below July 16 low on expanding volume.

Hold all 8 on 2025-07-22 (through July 21 close). July 21 firm, no breakdowns: AVGO +1.7% to 288.21 new high (high 290.54) on expanding 17.7M volume - leadership; KLAC +0.7% to 937.76 new high on low 674k; AAPL +0.6% to 212.48 (high 215.78) on 51M expanding; AMAT +1.1% to 192.61 bounce off 190.78 low holding above 189.75 trigger; MSFT flat 510.06 holding on low 14M; NVDA -0.6% to 171.38 low 171.0 held well above 168.9 on declining 123M; AMD flat 157.0 low 156.92 held above 155.61 breakout and 152.85 on declining 39M; BKNG -0.45% to 5677.15 low 5649.95 held above 5625 trigger. All triggers avoided. Only $513 cash. Reconsider if AMAT closes below 189.75, BKNG below 5625, AMD below 155.6/152.85, or NVDA below 168.9 on expanding volume.

Sell AMAT and KLAC on 2025-07-23 (through July 22 close). July 22 semi breakdown on expanding volume: KLAC -4.85% to 892.22 (low 890, close near low) on 1.62M vs 674k prior, closing below 897 trigger and July 16 low 897.38; AMAT -2.83% to 187.14 (low 185.13) on 7.07M vs 5.06M, closing below 189.75 trigger with 5-day downtrend and -5% loss vs 196.85 cost. Both violate prior hold triggers. Hold NVDA (167.03 below 168.9 on 193M expanding - weak but bounced off 164.58 low, still +2% vs cost, need confirmation), AMD (154.72 -1.45% low 149.34 bounced +3.6% off low, closed below 155.61 but above 152.85), AVGO (278.59 -3.3% but held above 275.67), MSFT (-0.9% to 505.27 holds), AAPL (+0.9% to 214.40 strength), BKNG (+1.7% to 5775.53 strength) for now. Raise ~$9.3k cash defensively (~19%) given semi distribution. Reconsider if NVDA/AMD/AVGO close below July 22 lows (164.58/149.34/276.43) on volume, or if KLAC/AMAT stabilize - would redeploy cash to strength.

Hold all 6 on 2025-07-24 (through July 23 close). July 23 bounce validates holding semis after July 22 washout: NVDA +2.2% to 170.78 (low 167.97) reclaiming 168.9 trigger on 154M vs 193M; AMD +2.5% to 158.65 (low 156) reclaiming 155.61 on 41.5M vs 49M; AVGO +1.8% to 283.69 (low 273, intraday under 275.67 but closed well above) on 20.5M expanding. MSFT flat 505.87 (low 500.70 held) on 16.4M, AAPL flat 214.15 holding highs on 46.9M, BKNG -0.7% to 5736.32 holding well above 5625 on 149k. No breakdowns. Keep ~$9.8k cash (~20%) defensively after AMAT/KLAC sales; one-day bounce insufficient to redeploy fully. Reconsider: add on follow-through above July 21 highs (NVDA 173.38/AVGO 290.54/AMD 160.34) or sell NVDA/AMD/AVGO if close below July 23 lows (167.97/156/273) on volume, MSFT below 500.7, BKNG below 5680, AAPL below 212.41.

Add to AMD and NVDA on 2025-07-25 (through July 24 close), hold MSFT/AVGO/AAPL/BKNG. July 24 follow-through confirms July 23 bounce: NVDA +1.7% to 173.74 closing above July 21 high 173.38 (high 173.83, low 171.30 held) ; AMD +2.2% to 162.12 closing above July 21 high 160.34 (high 163.93) on expanding 48.4M vs 41.5M; AVGO +1.8% to 288.71 with intraday 291.20 above 290.54 high on 16.4M. Meets prior add trigger. Deploy ~$5.5k of $9.8k cash to leaders: $3k AMD (strongest volume breakout), $2.5k NVDA (price breakout, volume lighter 129M vs 154M). Hold MSFT +1% to 510.88 (low 507.3 held) constructive, AVGO holding breakout, AAPL flat 213.76 holding highs on 46M. Hold BKNG -1.5% to 5650 on 172.5k expanding but low 5644 still above 5625.22 trigger - weak but no breakdown yet, keep tight stop. Keep ~$4.3k cash (~9%) buffer. Reconsider: sell adds if NVDA closes back below 171.3 / AMD below 158.36, sell AVGO below 283.5, MSFT below 507.3, AAPL below 212.41, BKNG below 5625 on volume.

Sell BKNG, add to MSFT and AVGO on 2025-07-28 (through July 25 close). BKNG -0.3% to 5632.27 third straight decline from 5775, low 5624.21 broke 5625.22 stop intraday on expanding 184.8k vs 172.5k (highest 10-day), close barely above - meets prior sell-below-5625-on-volume trigger, -1.9% vs cost and lagging strong semis. Rotate ~$4.9k proceeds to breakout leaders: MSFT +0.55% to 513.71 new high (high 518.29, low 510.36 held) on expanding 19.1M vs 16.1M; AVGO +0.5% to 290.18 breakout (high 292.59 above 290.54) holding above. Hold NVDA flat 173.5 (low 172.96 above 171.3) consolidating breakout on lighter 122M, AMD +2.7% to 166.47 strongest on expanding 53.4M, AAPL flat 213.88 holding highs on 40M. Keep ~$4.3k cash buffer. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510.3 / AVGO below 287.2, NVDA below 171.3, AMD below 162.36, AAPL below 212.41.

Hold all 5 on 2025-07-29 (through July 28 close). Semis accelerating: AMD +4.3% to 173.66 (high 174.70) on expanding 68.3M vs 53.4M strongest, +12.4% vs cost; NVDA +1.9% to 176.75 breakout (high 177.0, low 173.97 held) on 140M vs 122M; AVGO +1.4% to 294.30 new high (high 295.45, low 290.59 held) on 13.7M vs 12.5M. MSFT -0.2% to 512.50 pullback on lighter 14.3M vs 19.1M, low 510.12 near 510.36 support, close held - no breakdown. AAPL flat +0.1% to 214.05 holding highs on light 37.9M. No sell triggers hit. Keep ~$4.4k cash (~8.5%) buffer after prior BKNG rotation; fully deploying would leave zero buffer into extended semis. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510 on volume, NVDA below 173.9, AVGO below 290.5, AMD below 168.6, AAPL below 213.06.

Sell AAPL breakdown on 2025-07-30 (through July 29 close), hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/AMD. AAPL -1.3% to 211.27 (low 210.82, high 214.81) on expanding 51.4M vs 37.9M, closing well below prior 213.06 sell trigger and 212.41 support - breakdown with supply, meets exit rule. Rotate to cash buffer pending pullback: AVGO +1.1% to 297.42 new high on 19.2M vs 13.7M and AMD +2.2% to 177.44 on 108M vs 68M both extended with upper wicks (highs 302.19/182.31), chasing vertical spike risky; NVDA -0.7% to 175.51 reversal tail (high 179.38) on 154M expanding - hold but no add with low 175.02 still above 173.9; MSFT flat +0.07% to 512.57 holding on 16.5M - hold. Raise cash to ~$8.9k (~17%) for buffer. Reconsider: buy dip if AVGO holds above 294.8 / AMD above 174.6, sell NVDA below 173.9, MSFT below 510, AVGO below 290.5.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/AMD on 2025-07-31 (through July 30 close), keep ~$8.9k cash (~17%). All 4 up and holding triggers: NVDA +2.1% to 179.27 breakout (high 179.89, low 176.04 held above 173.9) on expanding 174.3M vs 154M strongest; AVGO +1.75% to 302.62 new high (high 303.26, low 295.80 held above 294.8) on lighter 16.7M vs 19.2M; AMD +1.2% to 179.51 (high 180.37, low 173.80 intraday dip below 174.6 but closed well above) on lighter 64.8M vs 108M - healthy digestion; MSFT +0.13% to 513.24 holding (low 509.44 intraday break of 510 but closed above) on heavy 26.4M vs 16.5M - no close breakdown so hold. No sell triggers hit on closing basis; semis extended (+8-16% vs cost) so no chase adds, preserve buffer. Reconsider: sell NVDA below 173.9, AVGO below 290.5, AMD below 168.6, MSFT below 510 on close with volume.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/AMD through 7/31 close, deploy ~$46k of $58.9k cash (incl $50k deposit) into 4 leaders, keep ~$13k buffer. MSFT +3.96% to 533.5 earnings gap (open 555.23 high 555.45 low 531.90 held) on 51.6M vs 26.4M - hold; NVDA -0.78% to 177.87 (high 183.3 low 175.93 held above 173.9) on 221M expanding - hold; AVGO -2.95% to 293.70 (high 306.95 low 290.23) on 25.5M expanding distribution but close held above 290.5 trigger - hold; AMD -1.78% to 176.31 (high 182.5 low 173) on 71.8M - close above 174.6/168.6 - hold. New buys: META +11.3% to 773.44 earnings breakout (open 775.2 high 784.75 low 765.51) on 38.8M vs 27M; APP +7.5% to 390.70 breakout (high 397.92 low 377.52) on 7.94M vs 2.25M; AMZN +1.7% to 234.11 (high 236.53) on 104M vs 33M breakout volume; DASH +0.9% to 250.25 new high (high 252.87) steady. Avoid AAPL/AMAT/KLAC/BKNG/NFLX/CRWD/PANW breakdowns on volume. Reconsider: sell META below 700, APP below 358, AMZN below 229, DASH below 240, NVDA below 173.9, AVGO below 290.5, AMD below 168.6, MSFT below 510 on close.

Sell AMZN breakdown through 8/01 close, hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/AMD/META/APP/DASH. AMZN -8.25% to 214.75 (open 217.21 high 220.44 low 212.80) on 122.3M vs 104.4M earnings gap down, closing well below 229/230.19 trigger and below 7/08-7/24 range - clear exit signal, cut to cash. Hold others: MSFT -1.77% to 524.11 (low 520.86) on lighter 29M vs 51.6M, above 510; NVDA -2.35% to 173.72 (low 170.89) on 204M vs 221M marginal 0.1% under 173.9 but held above 170-171 breakout zone - give room; AVGO -1.72% to 288.64 (low 281.61) on lighter 21.4M, retesting 288-290 breakout - hold; AMD -2.62% to 171.70 (low 166.82) on 75M, above 168.6 stop; META -3% to 750.01 on lighter 19M vs 38.8M above 700; APP -2.9% to 379.17 above 358; DASH -0.76% to 248.35 above 240 on 2.9M resilient. Raise cash to ~24k (~24%) defensive into weakness, no new buys. Reconsider: sell NVDA close below 170, AVGO below 281.6, AMD below 168.6, MSFT below 510, META below 700.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/AMD/META/APP/DASH through 8/04 close, keep ~$24.9k cash (~24%). Strong bounce reclaim day: MSFT +2.17% to 535.64 new high (high 538.25 low 528.13) on 25.3M vs 29M above 510; NVDA +3.6% to 180.0 (high 180.2 low 174.52) on 148M vs 204M reclaim well above 173.9/170; AVGO +3.17% to 297.72 (high 298.48) on 17.1M vs 21.4M back above 290.5; AMD +2.96% to 176.78 (high 177.86) on 52.9M vs 75M back above 174.6/168.6; META +3.53% to 776.37 new high above 773.44 (high 776.85) on 15.8M; APP +4.17% to 395.01 new high above 390.7 on 4.99M; DASH +3.89% to 258.02 new high (high 258.73) on expanding 3.35M vs 2.94M. No sell triggers hit, all holds confirmed, no new buys to avoid chasing extended bounce on lighter volume. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510, NVDA below 170, AVGO below 281.6, AMD below 168.6, META below 700, APP below 358, DASH below 240 on close.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/AMD/META/APP/DASH through 8/05 close, keep ~$24.9k cash (~24%). Pullback day: MSFT -1.47% to 527.75 (low 527.24) on lighter 19.2M vs 25.3M above 510; NVDA -0.97% to 178.26 on 156M vs 148M above 173.9/170; AVGO -1.61% to 292.93 (high 301.2 faded) on 18.5M vs 17.2M still above 290.5; AMD -1.4% to 174.31 (low 171.8) on expanding 88.8M vs 53M but held above 168.6; META -1.66% to 763.46 on lighter 11.6M above 700; APP -4.33% key reversal to 377.93 (high 399.94 low 376.91) on expanding 6.39M vs 4.99M back below 390.7 breakout but above 358 stop - hold to avoid whipsaw; DASH -1.06% to 255.28 on 3.63M above 240 near highs. No stops broken, no new buys into distribution. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510, NVDA below 170, AVGO below 281.6, AMD below 168.6, META below 700, APP below 358, DASH below 240 on close.

Sell AMD breakdown through 8/06 close, hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/META/APP/DASH. AMD -6.42% to 163.12 (open 165.05 high 166.18 low 157.80) on huge 133.6M vs 88.8M, closing well below 168.6 stop - clear distribution exit, cut to cash. Hold others: MSFT -0.53% to 524.94 (low 524.03) on 21.4M vs 19.2M above 510; NVDA +0.65% to 179.42 on lighter 137.2M vs 156.4M above 170; AVGO +3.0% to 301.67 new high (high 302.81) on 17.4M breakout strength; META +1.12% to 771.99 on light 9.7M near highs above 700; APP +3.34% to 390.57 (high 393.45 low 378.36) on 12.84M vs 6.39M reclaiming ~390.7 after reversal; DASH +1.10% to 258.08 new high on expanding 5.43M vs 3.63M. Raise cash defensive, no new buys into AMD shakeout. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510, NVDA below 170, AVGO below 281.6, META below 700, APP below 358, DASH below 240 on close.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/META/APP/DASH through 8/07 close, keep ~$38k cash (~36%). MSFT -0.78% to 520.84 (low 517.55) on lighter 16.08M vs 21.36M still above 510; NVDA +0.75% to 180.77 (high 183.88) on 151.9M vs 137.2M above 170; AVGO +0.69% to 303.76 new high close (high 310.34 low 299.88) on 16.32M; META -1.32% to 761.83 (low 759.55) on light 9.02M vs 9.73M above 700; APP +12.0% breakout to 437.34 (high 453.76 low 385.10) on huge 20.74M vs 12.84M; DASH +5.0% breakout to 270.99 (high 278.15) on huge 10.88M vs 5.43M. No stops broken, winners extending on volume, no sells. No new buys to avoid chasing parabolic APP/DASH gaps. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510, NVDA below 170, AVGO below 281.6, META below 700, APP below 358, DASH below 240 on close.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/META/APP/DASH through 8/08 close, keep ~$38k cash (~36%). MSFT +0.23% to 522.04 (high 524.66 low 519.41) on lighter 15.53M vs 16.08M above 510; NVDA +1.07% to 182.70 (high 183.30 low 180.40) on lighter 123.4M vs 151.9M above 170; AVGO +0.40% to 304.97 new high close (high 307.87 low 302.55) on lighter 12.46M vs 16.32M; META +0.98% to 769.30 (high 769.90 low 758.58) on light 7.32M vs 9.02M above 700; APP +4.26% continuation to 455.98 (high 464.98 low 447.02) on 9.49M vs 20.74M; DASH -4.35% pullback to 259.19 (open 269.46 high 270.07 low 254.39) on 5.34M vs 10.88M but held above 240 stop and near 258 breakout level. No stops broken, 5/6 up, no sells. No new buys to avoid chasing extended moves. Reconsider: sell MSFT below 510, NVDA below 170, AVGO below 281.6, META below 700, APP below 358, DASH below 240 on close.

Hold MSFT/NVDA/AVGO/META/APP/DASH through 8/11 close, keep ~$38k cash (~36%). MSFT -0.05% to 521.77 (high 527.59 low 519.72) on higher 20.19M vs 15.53M above 510; NVDA -0.35% to 182.06 (high 183.84 low 180.25) on 138.3M vs 123.4M above 170; AVGO -0.35% to 303.90 (high 308.31 low 301.29) on 12.40M above 281.6; META -0.45% to 765.87 (high 773.46 low 764.67) on 7.61M vs 7.32M above 700; APP +2.11% continuation to 465.58 (high 473.70 low 449.21) on lighter 5.98M vs 9.49M; DASH -1.20% to 256.09 (high 260.14 low 251.13) on lighter 4.74M vs 5.34M still above 240 stop. Broad mild pullback on 4/6, no stops broken, APP strength offsets. No sells. No new buys to avoid chasing extended APP.
